style: Modern tech flat vector illustration in dark violet-night (#1c1a24), magenta (#d15cff) and white, sharp angled shapes, subtle hatching, no text.

subjects.mecanique-generale: An open car engine bay seen from above with a plain smooth engine cover (no emblem, no badge); a hand-held diagnostic scanner lies on the fender, plugged in by its cable, a combination wrench beside it. No hands, no people.

hero: A modern repair bay at night: a car on a lift, a diagnostic cart with a glowing blank screen, magenta LED strips, a tidy tool wall. All cars are generic invented designs: no recognizable real models, no brand grilles, no badges or emblems. Flat vector, DARK violet-night overall, magenta highlights, white accents. Subject weighted to the right two thirds; the left third is plain dark background that fades smoothly (no hard edge, no panel, no frame). Interior only: no building exterior, no text, no signs, no logos, no license plates, no people, no numbers.
